title: ID0373256-DC/Si-D/FI - [MP / P8 170000820] Dispenser lock malfunction
description:
Location: Veturi, Kouvola
Reported behaviour/issue:
Technician was doing preventive maintenance. He informed me that dispenser door won't open. Seems like the lock located in the middle is not opening. RC-FI will break in through socket holder and manually release locking mechanism on week 33.
Root cause:
Solution: B
roke into the dispenser and released the lock manually.
